mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (display_name, employee_no, email, avatar_url, role, status, merged_into_user_id) VALUES (#{displayName}, #{employeeNo}, #{email}, #{avatarUrl}, #{role}, #{status}, #{mergedIntoUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET display_name = #{displayName}, employee_no = #{employeeNo}, email = #{email}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, role = #{role}, status = #{status}, merged_into_user_id = #{mergedIntoUserId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, display_name, employee_no, email, avatar_url, role, status, merged_into_user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id}
